stories.headline: Colombian Navy catches a go-fast boat carrying 1.6 tonnes of cocaine in the southern Pacific; the boat sank after hitting a navy vessel
stories.summary: Reported October 12, the Navy intercepted a speedboat in Colombia's southern Pacific waters with 1,620 kg of cocaine and 51 kg of marijuana aboard.
